name: Doodle
description: Doodle is a scheduling and coordination tool that finds a meeting time across a group's calendars via polls, booking pages, or one-on-one availability sharing.
best_for: Positioned for teams and organizations, as well as education, healthcare, professional services, and nonprofit sectors needing group and client-facing scheduling.
features: Group Polls to find a time that works for everyone
Sign-up Sheets for workshops and events
Stripe-based payment collection at time of booking

alternatives.name: Calendly
alternatives.description: A scheduling tool that connects to a user's calendar and lets them share a booking link for others to pick an open time slot.
alternatives.best_for: One-on-one and round-robin meeting booking with native mobile apps

alternatives.name: Cal.com
alternatives.description: An open, customizable scheduling platform where users share a booking link that syncs calendars and handles meeting logistics.
alternatives.best_for: Developers and teams wanting an open, customizable scheduling tool
